Mebrofenin in the average patient (70 kg) is: Nonjaundiced patient: 74 - 185 MBq (2-5 mCi) Patient with serum bilirubin level greater than 1.5 mg/dL: 111-370 MBq (3-10 mCi) The patient should be in a fasting state, 4 hours is preferable. False positives (non-visualization) may result
